questions.q: What happened when Passepartout tried a joyful vault on the San Francisco quay?
choices: He landed perfectly and the crowd clapped for him
He fell through some worm-eaten planks
He knocked Fix into the water by mistake
He slipped and broke his famous family watch
questions.evidence: tumbling upon some worm-eaten planks, he fell through them

questions.q: When did the first train for New York leave San Francisco?
choices: At six o'clock in the evening
At noon that very day
At seven the next morning
At midnight that night
questions.evidence: this was at six o'clock p.m.

questions.q: How had San Francisco changed since the days of 1849?
choices: It had shrunk into a small and quiet fishing town
It had gone from a city of outlaws to a great centre of trade
It had been burned down and was still being rebuilt
It had become the capital city of the whole of the United States of America
questions.evidence: it was now a great commercial emporium

questions.q: What seemed "very American" to Passepartout at the hotel bar?
choices: Food was free; people paid only for their drinks
Guests had to pay before they were allowed inside
Everyone ate standing up at one very long table
The waiters sang songs while serving the meals

questions.q: Why did Passepartout want to buy rifles and revolvers?
choices: He wanted to protect his master from Fix
He had heard stories of attacks on the trains
He planned to sell them later at a good profit in New York
Fogg had told him to buy them for the trip
questions.evidence: He had been listening to stories of attacks upon the trains

questions.q: Fogg met Fix "by the greatest chance in the world." Why is this phrase in quotation marks?
choices: Fix had planned the meeting
Fogg said the words out loud when he saw Fix
It was the name of a famous American song
Aouda said it to tease Fogg about his luck
questions.evidence: by the greatest chance in the world

questions.q: What was happening on Montgomery Street when they arrived?
choices: A parade for the opening of the new railway
A great crowd at a political meeting
A fire in a petroleum warehouse
A sale of goods from all over the world

questions.q: Fogg, Aouda and Fix were caught in a "tumultuous scene." What does "tumultuous" mean?
choices: Loud, wild and confused
Quiet and peaceful
Sad and gloomy
Neat and orderly
questions.evidence: observed the tumultuous scene with surprise

questions.q: Why did Fix want Mr. Fogg to stay safe in the crowd?
choices: He had grown to like Fogg as a true friend
He wanted Fogg unhurt until they got back to London
He was afraid Aouda would blame him for any harm
He owed Fogg money for the boat and wanted to repay it first
questions.evidence: anxious that Mr. Fogg should not receive any injury, at least until they got back to London

questions.q: Why were Fogg, Aouda and Fix suddenly trapped on the steps?
choices: A band of Mandiboy voters charged from behind
The police closed off both ends of the street
The steps collapsed under the weight of the crowd
A runaway omnibus blocked the only way out
questions.evidence: Mr. Fogg, Aouda, and Fix found themselves between two fires

questions.q: What did Fix do when the red-bearded man tried to strike Mr. Fogg?
choices: He pulled Aouda away to safety behind the steps
He rushed in and took the blow himself
He called for the police to arrest the man
He hit the man first with his walking-stick
questions.evidence: had not Fix rushed in and received it in his stead

questions.q: What was the name of the man who tried to hit Mr. Fogg?
choices: Mr. Camerfield
Colonel Stamp Proctor
Mr. Mandiboy
Mr. Batulcar

questions.q: Where did Fix suggest they go right after escaping the crowd?
choices: To a doctor
To a tailor's
To the police
To the station

questions.q: What did Fogg say he would do about Colonel Proctor?
choices: Forget all about him and never speak of him again
Come back to America to find him
Write a letter of complaint to the American government
Ask Fix to arrest him before they left the city
questions.evidence: I will come back to America to find him

questions.q: What is funny about the porter's answer at the end of the chapter?
choices: The huge riot had been over choosing only a justice of the peace
The porter had not even heard about the fight in the streets
The porter thought Fogg was one of the men running for office
The porter said the meeting had been about the Alabama question after all
questions.evidence: No, sir; of a justice of the peace.

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Fogg's day in San Francisco, where he is caught in a wild political brawl
Passepartout buying weapons and getting lost in the Chinese quarter
Fix arresting Fogg on Montgomery Street with an American warrant
Aouda deciding to stay in San Francisco and open a shop
questions.evidence: the contest between Camerfield and Mandiboy
